stoppingRule.selection: first 12 chronologically valid 6-window batches; invalid attempts excluded; post-target batch excluded

maker.concentration: All 10 maker candidates occurred in the first 18 formal windows; the final 54 formal windows had candidateCount=0.

supported: Public measurement/runtime produced a completed fixed 72-window Phase A sample.
Maker path produced one fully hedged protected-edge survivor under frozen measurement semantics.
notSupported: Evidence sufficient to estimate durable positive expected value or capital-scalable returns.
A return profile shown to exceed the user's Bitfinex lending benchmark.
limitations: Maker observation availability was 62.76%; 37.24% of scheduled time was unknown and is not interpreted as zero opportunity.
The single maker survivor was only 31.25 bps gross protected edge at the observed 5-share size, about USD 0.015625 gross.
Historical settlement/payoff mismatch risk remains unresolved and is not erased by the Phase A survivor.

disposition.rationale: The fixed Phase A sample does not support the intended high-frequency, durable, economically meaningful edge. Preserve the instrumentation and evidence; do not spend further primary engineering budget without a new independent mechanism or materially stronger external reason.
